parameters.name: DataSourceIds
parameters.description: The list of data source IDs. Up to 10 IDs are supported.

parameters.name: EnvType
parameters.description: The DataWorks environment type. Dev indicates the development environment. Prod indicates the production environment.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The metadata crawler name. Supports fuzzy match.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The DataWorks user ID of the crawler owner.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The crawler type. Call GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities to query the valid values supported in the current region.
